Customers stop messaging after 9 PM because they get no reply.

Most people browse services after dinner when they finally have free time.

If they send a message and wait eight hours, the initial buying momentum fades.

By the next morning they may forget why they reached out or choose a competitor who replied faster.

An AI chatbot on your website or WhatsApp can answer basic questions like pricing, timing, or services instantly.

It can help capture the enquiry while the prospect’s intent is highest, without disturbing your evening.
